verdicts.reason: A breaks the info block's grid: 'Saturday 21 June' is indented well right of the time/venue line and the chips, so the left edge is ragged. There is a big dead gap between the chips and the can, which drifts low on the right, and the partner placeholder is jammed against the URL line. B keeps the original's clean shared left edge for date, details and chips, and its hierarchy is intact. But it is essentially a shrunk copy: the chip text is tiny, everything is packed into the top two-thirds, and the bottom third is empty apart from a stray partner badge.
